title: Late-Cancellation Fee Supplement for In-Person Appointments Visits the Patient Moved
content:
**Supplement to the fee schedule, In-Person Appointments.** A sum is added to the late-cancellation fee a visit carries according to whether the patient moved the visit before cancelling it:

| Patient move before the cancellation | Added to the late-cancellation fee the visit carries |
|---|---|
| The patient moved the visit and the latest move was made 30 days or fewer before the cancellation date | 10.00 dollars |
| The patient moved the visit and the latest move was made more than 30 days before the cancellation date | 5.00 dollars |
| The patient never moved the visit | Nothing |

**Reading the records.** The patient has moved the visit when its appointment record shows a reschedule count of one or more patient-requested reschedules; the latest move is the date of the latest reschedule on that record, and its age is the number of days from that date to the cancellation date. Moves made by the clinic and waitlist moves do not raise the reschedule count.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical dates).**

- Latest move 2026-10-14, cancellation 2026-11-13: 30 days, so 10.00 dollars are added.
- Latest move 2026-10-13, cancellation 2026-11-13: 31 days, so 5.00 dollars are added.
- Reschedule count 0, cancellation 2026-11-13: nothing is added.
